latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor For – Edit and Export Finished Videos

- Instantly edits uploaded video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) via AI-powered cloud processing.
- Supports natural language instructions: cut pauses, add music, export for YouTube, and more.
- No editing software or skills needed; ideal for creators and marketers seeking quick results.
- Automatic token and session setup with clear connection status.
- Handles credits, session state, exports, and common actions via intuitive user prompts.
- Robust error handling for token, file type, size, and export restrictions.
